provenance: Explicit synthetic whole-deck recipes for apparatus validation, not sampled human runs or already restored native roots.

common.maxHp: Native character maximum, captured before execution.
common.relics: Native character starting relics only; resolve exact IDs and state into the captured manifest.
common.enemyHp: Native encounter HP and one native multiplayer scaling pass; no manual enemy HP override.
common.deckSemantics: Replace each precombat deck with the entire listed composition, expanded in listed order; native shuffle and draw then run normally. Never refill piles or resources between cycles.
common.initialResourcesAndPowers: Native combat-start state only; no injected energy, stars, block or powers.
common.construction: Build both character configurations inside one new native RunState and combat session, not by merging existing single-player runs.
common.choiceScope: No extra card-choice effects in the listed card pool; enemy target selection is still required. All relic, encounter and generated-card choice chains must be checked before admission.

admissionRequirements: Resolve every character, encounter, card and starting-relic ID against the declared game and mod environment.
Verify the native encounter is legal for the registered act and its active enemy count meets the recipe requirement.
Verify all starting, generated and triggered choices are absent or have a registered actor-owned adapter; reject the whole root instead of dropping a card.
Keep failed root admission in the planned-root and arm-availability report; do not silently replace or omit a candidate after seeing failures or comparative outcomes.
Capture exact ordered piles, card state, full party identity/resources/relics/potions, enemy state, native history, contribution ledger and all nine captured combat RNG streams.
Capture ready/phase/player-turn observations separately from the production search root and prove native action actor ownership.
Restore each captured root and compare complete party state before paired trajectories; a recipe or successful parse is not restoration evidence.
Freeze partner policy parameters, complete policy snapshots, search profiles and permitted treatment fields before measurement.

candidates.purpose: Local player is the only planned poison source; observe early peer kills and equal-share under-credit without assuming poison is actually played.
Both players can add to the same poison counter; no applier-based ownership is inferred from this recipe.

Check defense, setup and expected agreement without poison. Confirm zero unattributed exposure throughout relevant search paths and equal effective budgets before treating a cross-policy difference as an equivalence failure.
Observe poison investment, early kills and legal target changes with multiple native enemies; the required roster remains unverified until admission.
